user.title: MEGA account
user.description: Connect a MEGA account and pick the folder that will hold your Home Assistant backups. The folder is created when it does not exist yet, and nested folders can be separated with a slash.

data_description.folder: Folder in the MEGA Cloud Drive, for example `Home Assistant Backups` or `Backups/Home Assistant`.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.description: The MEGA account {email} is protected with two-factor authentication. Enter the current code from your authenticator app.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate MEGA account
reauth_confirm.description: The stored MEGA session for {email} has expired. Enter the password to log in again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to MEGA. Check your network connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: The email address or password is incorrect.
error.invalid_folder: The backup folder could not be created or used.
error.invalid_mfa: The two-factor authentication code was rejected.

abort.already_configured: This MEGA account is already configured.
abort.reauth_failed: Reauthentication failed, the config entry no longer exists.

init.title: MEGA Backup options
init.description: Change the folder in the MEGA Cloud Drive that stores your Home Assistant backups.

error.invalid_folder: The backup folder could not be created or used.
